summary: Every course must be letter graded. You take one political philosophy and one moral philosophy course of 4-5 units, two or three 100-level undergraduate courses of at least 3 units totaling 8 units that the Student Services Administrator approves, ETHICSOC 190 and 195, and ETHICSOC 200A, 200B and 200C totaling at least 10 units. Your advisor checks that the program's own courses are not also counted toward another program, and any transfer or abroad courses.
